apps_store_manage_denied: Your role can’t install or uninstall apps. Ask a workspace owner or admin.
apps_store_installed_empty: No apps installed yet. Install an app below to connect your systems.
apps_store_app_unavailable: This app is no longer available. Records it imported stay in Luma.
apps_store_connections_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} connection} other {{count, number} connections}}
apps_store_connections_attention: {count, plural, one {{count, number} connection needs attention} other {{count, number} connections need attention}}
apps_store_history_description: These apps aren’t installed. Open one to see its earlier connections.
apps_access_sensitive_note: Sensitive permissions can change data in your systems, move money, change access or approval rules, or read personal data.
apps_access_scope_not_grantable: Your role doesn’t include this, so you can’t grant it.
apps_access_install_description: {app} works for the people who use it. It can use the data and actions below, but never more than each person’s role allows.
apps_access_approve_description: {app} was updated and asks for more access. Until someone approves it, {app} keeps working with the access it already has.
apps_access_scopes_new_title: New data and actions {app} asks for
apps_access_no_scopes: {app} doesn’t use any data or actions in this workspace.
apps_access_permissions_note: Owners and admins get these permissions automatically. To give them to other roles, edit the role in Settings → Roles.
apps_access_missing_install: Your role doesn’t include all of this access, so you can’t grant it. Ask a workspace owner to install {app}.
apps_access_missing_approve: Your role doesn’t include all of this access, so you can’t grant it. Ask a workspace owner to approve it.
apps_settings_unavailable_description: This app is no longer available. Its earlier connections and imported records stay in Luma.
apps_settings_not_installed: {app} isn’t installed. Install it from Apps to add connections.
apps_settings_result_connected: Connection added. Luma confirmed it can read the data it needs.
apps_settings_result_permissions: Connection added, but Luma couldn’t confirm all the permissions it needs. Check the connection below.
apps_settings_result_denied: Authorization was declined, so no connection was added. Add the connection again to retry.
apps_settings_result_failed: Authorization couldn’t be completed. Add the connection again to retry.
apps_settings_pending_access: {app} was updated and asks for more access. It keeps working with its current access until someone approves the change.
apps_settings_manage_denied: Your role can’t add connections or change app settings. Ask a workspace owner or admin.
apps_settings_connections_empty_manage: Add a connection to start using {app}.
apps_settings_connections_empty_read: Connections appear here after someone with permission adds them.
apps_settings_access_description: Data and actions {app} can use in this workspace. When it works for someone, it never does more than that person’s role allows.
apps_settings_access_empty: {app} has no access to workspace data.
apps_settings_add_description: Connect an account so {app} can work with its data.
apps_uninstall_description: Uninstalling disconnects every {app} connection, deletes their stored credentials, and removes {app}’s permissions from all roles. Records already imported stay in Luma. Requests already sent to your systems may still finish.
apps_uninstall_roles: {count, plural, one {Reinstalling doesn’t restore these permissions. You’ll need to grant them to the {roles} role again.} other {Reinstalling doesn’t restore these permissions. You’ll need to grant them to these roles again: {roles}.}}
apps_extension_failed: This app couldn’t load. Refresh the page to try again.
apps_extension_unavailable: This app isn’t available in this workspace.
